answer_1.quote: This paper introduces the task of abstractive summarization of open-domain code-switched written conversations.
answer_1.outputs: English summaries from Hi-En code-switched conversations, Hi-En summaries from Hi-En conversations

answer_2.quote: The model performances are reported in terms of the following automatic evaluation metrics: ROUGE (R1, R2, RL), BLEURT, BERT-score, BLEU, and METEOR.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a human evaluation of the English summaries generated by all the models for a random selection of 100 Hi-En conversations. Following , we had three annotators rate the summaries for the following four metrics: consistency, coherence, fluency, and relevance on a Likert scale of 1 to 5.
answer_4.guideline: rate the summaries for the following four metrics: consistency, coherence, fluency, and relevance on a Likert scale of 1 to 5
